text: In an autokey the secret word only starts the key; then each letter is keyed by the message (or the cipher) a fixed distance back. The NSA suggested it for K4 in 1992.
After a turn in rows of 7, the L and O of CLOCK land 14 places apart; at lag 14 the copper gives U where O should be.
27,752 scramblings, lags 1 to 96, both orders, both kinds: nothing passes five checks; the four settings at four checks are scattered and match the scrambled coppers.
